title: Valve trombone and Long Charlie
summary: Barnes recalls the valve trombone, fingered like a trumpet with no slide, played by Long Charlie and used more like a bass part.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how
